baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled divorce root is immediately governed by the waiting-period and enumeration clauses.
baseline_models.mechanism: Marital unbinding is initiated, but its effects are stretched across an exhaustively counted interval. Release and restraint therefore coexist: the bond is being loosened while timing, residence, and later choice remain regulated.

activation_trace.role: The divorce-specific untying anchors the legal act whose temporal effects are being traced.
Release from a restraint supplies the mechanical image of a bond being loosened rather than a person being instantly discarded.
A legally counted duration turns release into a timed process with an intelligible endpoint.
Exhaustive enumeration makes attention to every unit of the interval part of the mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Divorce is a terminal declaration followed by a waiting rule.
changed_reading.after: Divorce opens a metered unbinding process whose count actively governs how release may unfold.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command to guard is followed by reciprocal prohibitions on expelling the women or their leaving their houses.
baseline_models.mechanism: The house remains a protective enclosure during a relational transition. The two directions of exit are blocked, so residence is not an incidental benefit but the spatial apparatus that prevents release from becoming exposure or forced disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Protection by placing a barrier against harm supplies the governing function of the residence rule.
The dwelling is the concrete shelter retained through the transition.
The marriage-house image keeps the relational space legally operative even while the marriage bond is being loosened.
Movement to the outside is the exact spatial transition suspended in both active and reflexive directions.
A distinguishing barrier gives the shelter rule its protected inside and prohibited outside.

changed_reading.before: Non-eviction is an ancillary housing protection after divorce.
changed_reading.after: Continued dwelling is the bounded shelter that makes a non-destructive transition possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Crossing God's boundaries is said to wrong the transgressor's own self.
baseline_models.mechanism: The limit acts as a feedback boundary. An outward attempt to accelerate or coerce the transition crosses a marked barrier and returns inward as a dislocation of the actor's own self; this reflexivity supplements rather than erases the harm done to the woman.

activation_trace.role: The marked barrier supplies the threshold whose crossing generates the feedback.
Exceeding a limit while doing wrong supplies the forbidden outward motion.
Putting something in the wrong place or time describes the disorder produced by forcing the transition.
The self as the thing itself identifies where the outward violation finally registers.

changed_reading.before: The boundary warning adds punishment to a divorce procedure.
changed_reading.after: The procedure contains a feedback law: violating the protected transition disorders the violator's own self.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The residence and boundary sequence ends by stressing human non-knowledge and the possibility of a later new affair.
baseline_models.mechanism: Counted time and continued shelter preserve options because the future is genuinely unavailable to the human agents. Restraint is therefore an epistemic practice: it refuses to make an irreversible spatial outcome before a not-yet-existent circumstance can emerge.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge and its explicit negation establish the agents' epistemic limit.
Something coming to be after not existing supplies a genuinely open future rather than a hidden fixed outcome.
Temporal afterness places emergence beyond the protected interval rather than inside the initial declaration.
A new affair or state is the possibility for which the interval keeps room.

changed_reading.before: The final possibility is consolation that reconciliation may happen.
changed_reading.after: Non-knowledge is a reason to preserve option space for any newly arising arrangement, without predetermining reconciliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counted interval does not merely postpone an already fixed separation. Reaching its limit opens two regulated actions, retaining or parting, and the repeated standard of recognized good governs either branch. The initial release is thus a reversible decision architecture until the term matures.

activation_trace.role: The initial loosening supplies a release process that can remain incomplete until the later gate.
The counted waiting duration carries the process to its decision point.
Arrival at a limit converts elapsed time into a functional gate.
Holding supplies one live action available at the gate.
Distinguishing and separating supplies the competing action at the same gate.
Recognized good constrains both alternatives, preventing either retention or separation from becoming coercive.

structural_cues: 65:2 places the paired alternatives only after the women reach their term.
The same manner phrase is repeated on both sides of the either-or construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, counted duration, arrival, holding, separation, and one repeated norm; I infer that the duration preserves both options until a gate rather than merely delaying execution. A live alternative is that the verse regulates only final paperwork after an irreversible decision.

changed_reading.before: The waiting period delays the completion of separation.
changed_reading.after: The waiting period preserves a two-way, norm-governed decision gate at its endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human agents must enumerate the interval exactly while being denied exhaustive reckoning of what will arrive. Human count is local and procedural; sufficiency, measure, and comprehensive knowledge remain divine. Precision and openness are therefore complementary rather than contradictory.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive enumeration supplies the strict human task whose scope must be delimited.
Negated human knowledge prevents procedural precision from becoming a claim to know the outcome.
Counting and reckoning are explicitly exceeded by provision arriving outside anticipated calculation.
Sufficiency relocates security from predictive calculation to adequate divine support.
Measured ordering supplies a wider determination within which the local human count operates.
Full disclosure to the knower contrasts with the focus agents' explicit non-knowledge.
Complete cognitive enclosure marks the comprehensive scale that human enumeration does not reach.

structural_cues: 65:3 places unreckoned provision beside a declaration that every thing has a measure.
65:12 closes the unit with comprehensive divine knowledge, answering the focus statement that the addressee does not know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact human enumeration, negated reckoning, assigned measure, human non-knowledge, and comprehensive divine knowledge; I infer a division between procedural responsibility and outcome control. The alternative is that the assurances concern livelihood only and do not qualify the counting command.

changed_reading.before: Exact counting is a means of mastering and predicting the divorce process.
changed_reading.after: Exact counting is disciplined responsibility inside a future that the counters neither calculate nor control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later differentiation of waiting by pregnancy activates the labor branch latent in the divorce root. Counted separation can be carried as a body-indexed transition until a burden is put down; release is painful emergence into a new state, not simply deletion of the old one.

activation_trace.role: Labor pain supplies the surprising release-through-process image inside the repeated divorce root.
Preparing provisions for an occurring matter turns the interval into active readiness rather than empty delay.
The inwardly carried pregnancy supplies a literal bodily clock that activates the labor image.
Putting down the pregnancy by birth supplies the transition's embodied endpoint.
Opening into ease after constriction gives the painful transition a release direction.

structural_cues: 65:4 makes pregnancy and delivery determine one class of waiting period.
The ayah closes by pairing guarded conduct with ease in the affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a labor branch in the focus divorce root and later literal pregnancy, delivery, and ease; I infer a cross-domain analogy in which separation is carried to an emergent state. The live alternative is that pregnancy only supplies a calendar rule and should not color non-pregnancy cases.

changed_reading.before: The waiting period is a homogeneous legal countdown.
changed_reading.after: The waiting period can be read as a body-sensitive gestational transition whose release may resemble labor.

context_deltas.mechanism: One root changes institutional mode across the unit: an unknown affair may emerge, a divine command descends, the parties deliberate together, and command descends through the created layers. The protected interval can therefore mediate between fixed norm and an undetermined arrangement worked out within it.

activation_trace.role: An affair or state names the undetermined possibility left open at the focus ending.
Command and obligation supply the known norm that structures the open interval.
Delivery downward presents the norm as received rather than improvised by the stronger party.
Mutual consultation supplies a human process through which a new practical arrangement can be formed.
Command at the cosmic scale keeps human deliberation nested within a larger order.
Ongoing descent through levels extends the delivered-command image from household procedure to created order.

structural_cues: The same root occurs as an indefinite future affair in 65:1, divine command in 65:5, reciprocal deliberation in 65:6, and cosmic command in 65:12.
Descent language accompanies the command at both the legal and cosmic scales.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated forms and distinct branch images for affair, obligation, consultation, and descent; I infer that obedience protects a space where a new arrangement may be deliberated. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no intended movement among these modes.

changed_reading.before: God may later introduce an unspecified event after the divorce command.
changed_reading.after: The known command can shelter mutual deliberation through which an as-yet-unknown arrangement emerges under a larger order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibition on expulsion expands into positive housing and expenditure duties, an explicit ban on harmful constriction, and a capacity ceiling. Shelter is thus maintained against indirect eviction: one may not achieve forbidden exit by making continued residence materially impossible.

activation_trace.role: The focus dwelling supplies the protected material location whose usability is at issue.
Exit is the prohibited result, including when pressure rather than direct force produces it.
Settling in a dwelling converts non-expulsion into an affirmative housing duty.
Deliberate reciprocal harm identifies coercion as a prohibited housing tactic.
Constriction of available space names the mechanism by which nominal shelter could be made unlivable.
Money going out as support supplies the material maintenance needed to keep protection real.
Capacity and endurance scale the support duty without nullifying it.
A ceiling on imposed burden prevents the protection rule from becoming a new form of impossible demand.

structural_cues: 65:6 orders housing from the same kind of place and means as the addressees possess, then forbids harm for the purpose of constriction.
65:6-7 continue from residence to pregnancy support, compensation, spending by means, and a burden ceiling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies housing, harm, constriction, expenditure, capacity, and burden; I infer that indirect economic pressure causing exit belongs to the same prohibited mechanism as direct expulsion. The alternative is that these are separate duties with no anti-eviction causal link.

changed_reading.before: The husband must refrain from physically removing the woman.
changed_reading.after: He must sustain usable, proportionate shelter and may not engineer exit through harm, constriction, or withheld support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's small-scale counting is mirrored by the severe accounting of a community that defied command. The number root then shifts from counting a waiting period to a prepared consequence. Careful procedural self-accounting functions as a protection against the larger account produced by boundary refusal.

activation_trace.role: Counting the immediate procedure supplies the local account that can be kept faithfully.
Rebellion against obedience supplies the large-scale analogue of crossing the focus boundaries.
Severe counting and accounting reverse the focus agents from counters into the counted.
The terminal outcome supplies the delayed return of ignored procedural choices.
General loss names the net result of refusing the protective order.
Preparation for an occurring matter turns the focus's count root into the preparation of consequence.

structural_cues: 65:8-10 runs from defiance of command through severe account and experienced loss to a prepared punishment.
The focus command to count and the later verb of preparation share the same root but activate different branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies local counting, communal accounting, consequence, loss, and the same root used for preparation; I infer a protective counter-account structure linking procedural care to avoided reckoning. The alternative is rhetorical recurrence without a designed reversal of agent and object.

changed_reading.before: Counting the waiting period is clerical compliance.
changed_reading.after: Local self-accounting is a protective practice that keeps boundary violation from ripening into a harsher account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same exit root governs a forbidden removal from shelter and a welcomed extraction from darkness. Movement itself is not the moral constant; agency, container, and destination are. The focus protects physical inside-space so that transition need not become exposure, while the later movement opens toward light and entry into a sustaining inside.

activation_trace.role: Passing to the outside supplies the movement prohibited when its source is the protected dwelling.
Shelter identifies the valuable inside from which forced exit would expose the resident.
The repeated causative exit becomes beneficial when it removes people from darkness toward illumination.
Illumination supplies the destination that reverses the value of exit.
Entry into a sustaining inside completes the constructive movement rather than leaving the person exposed.

structural_cues: 65:1 negates both causing the women to exit and their exiting from houses.
65:11 uses causative exit from darkness toward light and immediately follows it with entry into gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one exit root in opposite evaluations, plus shelter, light, and entry; I infer that the focus rule evaluates trajectories by source and destination rather than treating all separation as evil. The alternative is that domestic and salvific exits are unrelated uses with no mutual clarification.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply forbids movement out of the marital home.
changed_reading.after: It forbids an exposing trajectory out of shelter, while leaving room for transitions whose direction is from constriction toward illumination and renewed belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a labor-pain branch of the divorce root beyond the ordinary legal sense; it remains anchored in the repeated focus root and is awakened by literal pregnancy and delivery in 65:4. Downstream prose should present it only as a process analogy, never as a claim that every divorce concerns pregnancy or guarantees a beneficial rebirth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated divorce root carries a labor branch, while the focus ends with something new coming into being after the interval.

activation_trace.role: Labor pain supplies release as a difficult emergence rather than instantaneous severance.
Coming into being after not existing supplies the emergent social state at the analogy's endpoint.
Literal inward carrying makes the latent labor image contextually audible.
Birth as putting down a carried burden gives the analogy a bounded completion.

changed_reading.before: Divorce erases a relationship through a declaration.
changed_reading.after: Divorce may be carried as painful social labor through which a different state eventually comes into being.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it materializes enumeration through the pebble image rather than taking the verb abstractly; it remains anchored in the focus's enumeration and boundary roots and is sharpened by the later severe account. It should be rendered as a mnemonic or material analogy for auditable time, not as a historical claim about a prescribed counting technology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins exhaustive enumeration to marked boundaries within the same procedural sequence.

activation_trace.role: The pebble supplies a discrete material unit through which otherwise invisible elapsed time can be imagined as auditable.
The barrier image lets accumulated units mark a boundary rather than merely total a duration.
The later severe account raises the stakes of making the focus interval visibly accountable.

changed_reading.after: Each counted unit can be imagined as a pebble-like marker that constructs and audits the protective temporal boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-scale reading is surprising because it aligns a domestic enclosure with layered heavens and earth; it remains anchored in the focus house, boundary, and affair and in 65:12's spatial layers, descending command, and encompassing knowledge. Downstream prose must call it a formal analogy of nested order, not equate a household with the cosmos or infer cosmology from divorce law.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A bounded house shelters an unknown emerging affair, and the closing ayah depicts command moving among bounded cosmic levels.

activation_trace.role: The dwelling supplies the local protected inside used in the cross-scale spatial analogy.
A distinguishing barrier gives the local space an ordered edge.
The overshadowing upper levels supply one side of the nested cosmic enclosure.
The lower counterpart supplies the other side of the layered spatial order.
Descent through the layers supplies regulated movement without collapse of their distinctions.
Comprehensive enclosure in knowledge contains the larger system within which the local unknown remains real to human agents.

changed_reading.before: The housing boundary is a narrow domestic regulation.
changed_reading.after: The household can be carried as a local model of differentiated spaces through which order moves while bounded inhabitants act under partial knowledge.

strongest_changes: The counted interval became a reversible decision gate rather than a delay before a fixed ending.
Non-expulsion became affirmative, capacity-scaled material protection against direct and indirect coercion.
Exact human counting became compatible with radical non-control because measure and comprehensive knowledge remain divine.
The affair root moved among command, consultation, and emerging circumstance, keeping fixed norm and open outcome together.
Later severe accounting turned the focus count into a protective local counter-account.
summary.what_was_special: The unit repeatedly changed the role of the same focus anchors: release remained sheltered, counting exposed the limits of reckoning, exit reversed value with its destination, and an affair moved between obligation, deliberation, and emergence. Those reversals preserved several coexisting readings instead of collapsing the ayah into either procedure or consolation.
remaining_uncertainties: The labor activation is textually anchored but may be only a productive analogy rather than an intended extension beyond pregnant cases.
The reversal from counting the interval to severe accounting and prepared consequence may be deliberate root play or only rhetorical recurrence.
The household-to-cosmos alignment is formally coherent but remains cross-scale and should not carry doctrinal weight.
The new affair can include reconciliation, separation terms, support arrangements, or another circumstance; the trace should not force one referent.
